The *Ambavanapetavatthu* (Pv 47), translated as "The Mango Ghost," is a canonical Buddhist verse narrative included in the *Petavatthu* [SuttaCentral]. The text explores the spiritual consequences of sharing merit with departed relatives, addressing what occurs when merits are dedicated on their behalf [SuttaCentral].
